thread:
jordan: quick question — we're seeing ~0.6% of prod traffic hit v1 fallback but no corresponding client version in telemetry. guessing it's mobile SDKs dropping the X-Redwood-Version header. anyone seen this pattern?
hema: I noticed similar in the dashboard last night. fallback_rate spiked for a few tenants, but version_signal:unknown was most of it.
lucas: yeah, mobile SDKs historically strip unknown headers when going through older proxies. could be our mobile proxy rewrite.
nate: @hema can you paste the query you used? want to compare to the rollout buckets.
hema: simple PromQL: sum by (tenant, signal) (increase(version_signal_total[1h])) and then rate(fallback_count[5m]) as a ratio. saw cluster of tenants with signal="" and fallback_rate ~0.5%.
jordan: thanks. two quick asks: 1) if header missing, do we want to surface "client_unknown" in console instead of hiding? 2) sampling cost — we currently log full headers for 100% of sampled requests; might want to sample the sampling itself.
lucas: for UI I'd prefer explicit "missing header" badge so eng teams can triage. hiding makes it look like we lost telemetry.
platform-bot: note: updated rollout-sensor config — default sample-rate unchanged. (config: rollout-sensor.v=0.8)
nate: re: sampling cost — we could do hierarchical sampling: 1% of requests annotated as "version-sample" and of those capture full headers. approximate math: 1% * 0.01 = 0.0001 for full debug capture.
hema: hierarchical sounds right. also propose a tiny console affordance: a toggle "show missing header examples" that flips a low-volume sample (0.01%) into the debug capture path and shows 20 examples for 24h.
jordan: agree. UX should warn about PII and link to scrub rules. also want a metric showing "clients_updating" = count of distinct client versions seen over rolling 7d — helps detect slow migrations.
lucas: ops question: if we surface "missing header" to tenants, do we auto-assign to support? might flood SRE. Maybe only show in tenant console with an action button to create a support ticket.
hema: good call. make it owner-driven. console shows badge + "collect examples" button. button triggers the low-volume capture and creates a private audit log event.
jordan: implementation plan sketch: a) update proxy to add X-Redwood-Version: "" explicitly when absent (so signal isn't null), b) update metrics pipeline to treat "" as "missing-header" bucket, c) add hierarchical sampling toggle + console button. estimate: 2 dev days + 1 ops day.
nate: I'll open a backend PR for the metric mapping and sampling config. tagging: @lucas for proxy changes.
lucas: ok I can do the proxy change tomorrow, but need to coordinate with infra for canary.
jordan: thanks. last: telemetry names — avoid mixing "unknown" and "missing-header" in queries. choose canonical label: missing_header. we'll migrate old dashboards to alias missing_header -> unknown for 30d.
platform-bot: reminder: deploy-window tomorrow 15:00-17:00 UTC. plan changes should target canary then.
hema: cool. I'll update dashboard and add docs snippet: code example to send header from clients: ```curl -H "X-Redwood-Version: 2.4.1" https://api.redwood.example/v2/generate```
jordan: perfect. file followups in #eng-platform-prs. thanks all. :thumbsup:
